author: Rudyard Kipling
text: The Eldest Magician is sitting on his magic throne, [[1]] up in his Magic Cloud. The three flowers in front of him are the three Magic Flowers. On the [[2]] of the hill you can see All-the-Elephant-there-was, and All-the-Cow-there-was, and All-the-Turtle-there-was going off to play as the Eldest Magician told them.
explanation: 1 — wrapped up (закутанный); 2 — on the top of the hill (на вершине холма).

author: Lewis Carroll
text: “Now one can breathe more easily,” said the Knight, putting back his [[1]] hair with both hands, and turning his [[2]] face and large [[3]] eyes to Alice. She thought she had never seen such a strange-looking soldier in all her life.
explanation: 1 — shaggy: косматый; 2 — gentle: мягкий, кроткий; 3 — mild: мягкий, добрый.

author: Lord Dunsany
text: She was as a sun-stricken mountain uplifted alone, all beautiful with ice, a [[1]] and lonely radiance late at evening far up beyond the comfortable world, not quite to be companioned by the stars, the doom of the [[2]].
explanation: 1 — desolate: безлюдный, пустынный по смыслу; 2 — mountaineer: альпинист, подходит по контексту к горе.
